headline: Seattle Pacific alone still without a draw
dek: Western Washington drew at Regis on Sunday, and Seattle Pacific are now the only programme in the conference yet to share the points. Seattle Pacific have won five matches and lost one, and that defeat came at Regis too, earlier in the same week.
